name: Kamisori Barber
description: Kamisori Barber — a barbershop theme read as one long column: under a formal top header (shop name, menu and the Book a chair button in one bar, a full-screen kyo-murasaki overlay on phones and tablets) every section keeps its text in a single centred reading column, and the pictures hang out into the margins as torn, taped paper-cut pieces. Kyo-murasaki (#9D5B8B), the old Kyoto purple, is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are murasaki fields set in white. The hero breaks the frame: a paper-cut picture of the shop in a white window frame, with a cut-out barber chair (transparent WebP) breaking out of the frame and over the hero bottom edge; a cut-out shaving mug and brush breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a layered paper-cut illustration in murasaki, lilac, sumi and muted gold. Chokokutai for display (with a Zen Maru Gothic kanji subset in Japanese), Epilogue for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-14 (single-column-longform, cutout-break-frame-object hero, top-bar nav, collage, paper-cut, kyo-murasaki #9D5B8B, Chokokutai + Epilogue, fashion-beauty). A formal top header with the shop name, the menu and the Book a chair button in one bar. Chokokutai has kana but few kanji, so Japanese headings add a Zen Maru Gothic kanji subset. Vertical type only in Chinese and Japanese; Latin text stays horizontal. Break-frame: the cut-out barber chair breaks out of the window frame and over the hero bottom edge, the cut-out shaving brush over the story band and every page head.

summary.zh-TW: 京紫色的三椅理髮店：去背理髮椅從窗框破格而出，單欄長文式頁面，撕紙膠帶拼貼的剪紙插畫，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A kyo-murasaki barbershop: a cut-out chair breaking out of the window frame, one long reading column, taped paper-cut collage.
summary.ja: 京紫の三席の床屋。窓枠を越える切り抜きの理容椅子、一本の長い段組み、テープで留めた切り絵のコラージュ。
summary.fr: Un barbier violet kyo-murasaki : fauteuil détouré qui sort du cadre, une longue colonne de lecture, collage de papier découpé.
summary.de: Ein Barbier in Kyo-Murasaki: freigestellter Stuhl, der den Rahmen sprengt, eine lange Lesespalte, Scherenschnitt-Collage.
